text.en:
Priority number five, page twenty-eight-B, Group III, for the Province of Cebu, Appendix B of Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen, is amended to read as follows:
"5a. Carcar, Talut—Completion and painting ₱1,000.00 "5b. Carcar, Poblacion—Repair, improvement and painting of Central School Home Economics Building 2,500.00 "5c. Carcar, Valencia—Completion and painting of Home Economic Building 1,500.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
